name: Kanno Iori
source:
The student council president who is quite innocent despite her appearance.
She is energetic and full of energy in everything she does.
Since taking office as president, three changes have been made to the school regulations through her efforts.
She often rushes and does reckless things, but she gets through it with her good nature and momentum.
For better or for worse, she is a slave to her desires, so while she goes straight for whatever she decides to do, she also has the side of being extremely lazy when it comes to things she is not interested in.

Translated from https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1273918
